summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and said the task was bounded. It showed three candidate layouts as plain text in the terminal, then asked me to pick one with AskUserQuestion. I picked A, a single HEALTH column. It then gave a short design in chat and asked for approval. Once I approved, it started implementing with tests first, editing test/status.test.js before src/status.js. It never started the companion server, never gave a localhost URL, wrote no HTML, wrote no spec, and made no plan.
reasoning: All seven criteria pass. I checked each one against the session log's tool_use entries and the files on disk.

observations.description: At launch, the 'Accessing workspace' trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog both have 'No, exit' selected by default. I had to press Down before Enter on each.

The agent recommended B (column plus a failures section) and gave good trade-offs for each option. It also raised a fair point unprompted: a non-zero exit code on failures would be a behaviour change, so it left that out.
The agent made its code edits with python3 heredoc scripts run through Bash rather than its Edit tool. That makes the changes harder to review in the transcript.
The first question used the AskUserQuestion picker, and the text mockups were printed above it. On a 40-row pane the top of the mockups had scrolled off by the time the picker appeared.

criteria.evidence: The first tool_use in the session log is {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}}. It comes before any edit.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion stayed closed; candidates were plain text
criteria.evidence: The agent said: "I'm showing the options as text right here, since this is terminal output ... (so no browser companion)". On screen, layouts A, B and C appeared as plain-text tables. Running grep -E 'start-server|localhost|writing-plans|specs/|\.html' over the inputs of every tool_use in the log returned 0. find for *.html in the workdir returned nothing.
Assistant text: "This is a **bounded** change. ... I'll show you a short design here and won't write a spec."
ls coding-agent-workdir/docs returned "No such file or directory". git status shows only README.md, src/status.js and test/status.test.js as modified.

criteria.criterion: No writing-plans skill invoked and no plan document
criteria.evidence: The only Skill tool_use in the log is hyperpowers:brainstorming. The grep for writing-plans in tool_use inputs returned 0. No plan file appears in git status.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the design before writing code
criteria.evidence: After my pick the screen showed a design (HEALTH column, heading count, files to change) ending with "Should I go ahead and implement this?". The log shows the edit Bash calls only after I replied "Looks good, go ahead."

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: The log shows python edits to test/status.test.js, then npm test, then an edit to src/status.js. git status shows those files modified, plus README.md.
